story_description: Define theme models and built-in theme presets for the settings system.
task_description: Themes need semantic color definitions (background, surface, accent, text, states) that override system colors. A dedicated struct ensures color consistency and easy serialization.
atom_description: Themes need semantic color definitions (background, surface, accent, text, states) that override system colors. A dedicated struct ensures color consistency and easy serialization.
problem_statement: Themes need semantic color definitions (background, surface, accent, text, states) that override system colors. A dedicated struct ensures color consistency and easy serialization.
scope_in: Define ThemeColors struct with semantic color properties; provide Codable conformance; support optional overrides (nil = use system default)
Implement ThemeColors.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Color application to DSColors (handled by ThemeManager); color picker UI
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.

functional_requirements: ThemeColors stores: background, surface, surfaceHover, accent, accentHover, textPrimary, textSecondary, textMuted, border, success, warning, error (all optional Color?)
Provides `resolved(with systemColors: DSColors) -> DSColors` method to merge with defaults
Use DSGlass styling for any settings panels or UI surfaces.
Persist user choices via the specified storage mechanism.
Support all semantic tokens: background, surface, surfaceHover, accent, accentHover, textPrimary, textSecondary, textMuted, border, success, warning, error.
Hex encoding uses #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA format and decodes to Color.
Resolved theme colors merge ThemeColors with DSColors defaults.
nonfunctional_requirements: Color parsing must handle invalid hex gracefully (return nil)
Must not block the main UI thread.
implementation_steps: Define struct with optional Color properties
Implement custom Codable using hex strings
Add tests for hex parsing edge cases
Review the ThemeColors.swift section in docs/settings-development.md and confirm required fields and flows.
data_model_changes:
struct ThemeColors: Codable, Equatable {
var background: Color?
var surface: Color?
var surfaceHover: Color?
var accent: Color?
var accentHover: Color?
var textPrimary: Color?
var textSecondary: Color?
var textMuted: Color?
var border: Color?
var success: Color?
var warning: Color?
var error: Color?
func resolved(with system: DSColors) -> ResolvedThemeColors
}
